plugin.name: SpotifySoloist
plugin.creator: cortegedusage
plugin.title: Spotify Soloist (Connect)
plugin.desc: Run Spotify Soloist as a Spotify Connect target for your Lyrion players. One independent Connect device per selected Squeezebox player, direct FIFO-backed audio injection into Lyrion, and real Now Playing metadata including cover art. Uses the direct-PCM shim by default without a Pulse/PipeWire server, with the Pulse/PipeWire bridge still available as an alternative.
